clue.text: Story about Spaniard deserving forgiveness

indicators.note: about means going round, so the story wraps itself around the Spaniard

parts.note: a parable is a story with a moral
Don is a Spanish title for a gentleman, so a Spaniard

explanation.surface: A tale about a Spanish man who has earned a pardon.
explanation.definitionFit: Something excusable can be forgiven, so it merits pardon.

clue.text: Calm down quickly if captured

indicators.note: captured means the word if is held inside the word for quickly

parts.note: pacy means fast, moving quickly

explanation.surface: An instruction to settle down fast if someone is caught.
explanation.definitionFit: To soothe someone is to make them peaceful.

clue.text: Priest before worship

parts.note: Rev, short for Reverend, is a priest's title
ere is an old word for before

explanation.surface: A cleric arriving ahead of a service.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold someone in deep awe is to venerate them.

clue.text: Traditional place of worship in the east

definitions.text: Traditional place of worship in the east

parts.note: orthodox means conventional or traditional
a church is a place of worship

explanation.surface: A description of an old-style eastern temple.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines the Eastern Christian communion, while 'Traditional' and 'place of worship' also build it piece by piece.
explanation.definitionFit: The Eastern Christian body centred historically on Constantinople keeps ancient liturgy.

clue.text: Gorilla at loggerheads with reptile

indicators.note: being at loggerheads suggests conflict, so the letters of gorilla at are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A gorilla quarrelling with a large reptile.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at' is part of the fodder, not just the idiom 'at loggerheads'.
explanation.definitionFit: A large scaly crocodilian of American rivers.

clue.text: Arnold endlessly confused her

indicators.note: confused says the remaining letters are mixed up
endlessly means the final letter of the name is removed

explanation.surface: Arnold, flustered, endlessly baffling a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' cuts the D from ARNOLD, leaving ARNOL, which 'confused' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A female name stands for a woman, as the pronoun does.

clue.text: It flies about in two different directions

indicators.note: in tells us the word for about sits inside the two compass points

parts.note: W and N are the compass abbreviations for west and north
re is Latin-derived crossword shorthand for about or concerning

explanation.surface: Something flying this way and that across the sky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'two different directions' supplies two compass letters, W and N, which hold RE between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A small songbird is a creature that takes to the air.

clue.text: Iris' hint about inflammation

indicators.note: about here means the letters are moved around

explanation.surface: Iris dropping a hint about a medical swelling.
explanation.definitionFit: Swelling of the nasal lining, as in a head cold.

clue.text: Hazel's external protection — naturally

parts.note: Hazel reads like a woman's name, but it is the hazel tree, whose kernel is guarded by a hard natural casing

explanation.surface: A woman named Hazel wearing her own natural armour.
explanation.definitionFit: The woody casing around a hazel's kernel is its natural protective cover.

clue.text: Again with gradual training process restoring to original state

parts.note: re- is a prefix meaning again
conditioning is gradual training of behaviour

explanation.surface: Repeated training described as bringing something back to how it was.
explanation.definitionFit: Overhauling something brings it back to good working order.

clue.text: It is not right in secret to desire what belongs to another

definitions.text: to desire what belongs to another

indicators.note: not here means the letter for right is to be left out of the secret word

parts.note: covert means secret or hidden

explanation.surface: A moral warning that secretly wanting other people's things is wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: To yearn for another's property is the sin named in the Tenth Commandment.

clue.text: One taking clarinets off

indicators.note: off suggests the letters of clarinets have gone wrong and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone making off with woodwind instruments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One taking' means a thief, someone who takes what is not theirs.
explanation.definitionFit: A thief commits theft, the crime of stealing property.

clue.text: Length of coat, lengthy!

parts.note: an animal's coat is its fur
long means lengthy

explanation.surface: Remarking on how long a fur coat is.
explanation.definitionFit: An eighth of a mile is a unit of distance used in horse racing.

clue.text: Do away with Jack, look back at his mess

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, and AB (able seaman) is crossword shorthand for a sailor

indicators.note: mess means the letters of his are jumbled

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or behold

explanation.surface: Telling Jack to turn round and see the muddle he has made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back at' is linking glue in the surface; JACK as a sailor gives AB, a crossword convention.
explanation.definitionFit: To end a law or practice formally is to scrap it entirely.

clue.text: Left the ground with William on the Dorset coast

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
land means the ground
Bill is a short form of the name William

explanation.surface: Someone departing the land with a man called William.
explanation.walkthrough: Dorset is a county on England's south coast; this headland juts out there at the tip of the Isle of Portland.
explanation.definitionFit: This promontory is a well-known headland and lighthouse site in southern England.

clue.text: Lady from Warsaw stopping short in Maryland

parts.note: Anna is a woman's name

indicators.note: stopping short means the last letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: Warsaw is in Poland, so something from there is Polish

explanation.surface: A Polish woman whose journey ends early.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stopping short' cuts the H from POLISH, leaving POLIS.
explanation.definitionFit: The state capital of Maryland, home of the US Naval Academy.

clue.text: Protection you said wayward soul needs when addicted to strong drink

parts.note: a bib protects clothing when eating

indicators.note: said means the word you is heard as a single letter

parts.note: you sounds like the letter U

indicators.note: wayward means the letters of soul stray into a new order

explanation.surface: A lost soul who needs a bib because they drink too much.
explanation.definitionFit: Fond of alcohol to excess, a heavy tippler.

clue.text: Extra material to tot up — finish with hesitation

parts.note: to tot up is to add
end means finish
um is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Adding up a sum and ending with a pause.
explanation.definitionFit: A supplement appended to a book or document.

clue.text: Teach getting degree during remarkable interaction

indicators.note: during says the degree letter comes in the middle of the rearranged word
remarkable hints that the word interaction has been strikingly altered

explanation.surface: Learning that happens through a striking exchange between people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting degree' reads as earning a qualification, but the degree is just the letter D, which 'during' drops into the reshuffled word that 'remarkable' signals.
explanation.definitionFit: To drill beliefs into someone is to instruct them forcefully.

clue.text: Some tribes to wander to lodge

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Wandering tribes looking for somewhere to settle.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic sense meaning to place or house someone somewhere.

clue.text: Earlier, before end of day, was found in monastery

indicators.note: before places the word for earlier ahead of the last letter

parts.note: prior means earlier

indicators.note: end of means take the last letter of the word day

explanation.surface: Something discovered in a religious house before nightfall.
explanation.definitionFit: A religious house of monks or nuns headed by a prior.

clue.text: A French peer is not fit

parts.note: un is French for a
a peer is an equal

explanation.surface: A French aristocrat described as unwell.
explanation.definitionFit: Being inadequate to a task means lacking the capacity for it.

clue.text: Lady working in field

indicators.note: in says the word for working is placed within the field

parts.note: lea is a poetic word for a meadow or field
on means working or operating

explanation.surface: A woman labouring out in a meadow.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's given name stands for a female person.

clue.text: Be the first individual to enter landing-stage

indicators.note: to enter means the word for individual goes inside the landing-stage

parts.note: a pier is a landing-stage for boats
one means a single individual

explanation.surface: A single person stepping onto a jetty ahead of others.
explanation.definitionFit: To blaze a trail is to lead the way before anyone else.

clue.text: Tie with former place of education

explanation.surface: Talk of a neckwear linked to one's earlier school.
explanation.walkthrough: An old school tie is the striped tie of a British public school, so the phrase completes 'Tie'; the second reading is simply a school one once attended.
explanation.definitionFit: The first sense is the phrase that precedes tie in the British public-school neckwear; the second is literally an earlier academy one went to.

clue.text: Opening passage, it was left out of anthem

indicators.note: was left out of says the word it is dropped from the anthem

parts.note: an introit is a chant or anthem sung at the start of a church service
taken as written

explanation.surface: Remarking that the start of a song was skipped.
explanation.definitionFit: A short lead-in at the start of a piece of music or broadcast.

clue.text: Back American member finding oil here

indicators.note: back means the word for American is read backwards

parts.note: an MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: Supporting a US politician who strikes oil.
explanation.definitionFit: The reservoir at the bottom of an engine is where lubricant collects.

clue.text: Piece of music with style found in corridor

parts.note: a passage is a section of a piece of music
way means manner or style

explanation.surface: A stylish snatch of music heard in a hallway.
explanation.definitionFit: A long narrow route connecting rooms in a building.
